sql:
SELECT
  c.company_name,
  COUNT(d.posting_key) AS open_remote_us_listings_count
FROM dim_company AS c
JOIN fct_posting AS d
  ON c.company_key = d.company_key
WHERE
  d.remote_us = TRUE
GROUP BY
  c.company_name
ORDER BY
  open_remote_us_listings_count DESC
LIMIT 3
